instruction_units.title: 1. Descending Scalar Run
instruction_units.instruction: The left hand moves stepwise down from C4 to Bb3 at m.5-7, covering 5 semitones across 4 notes. Steps: -2, -1, -2.

instruction_units.title: 2. Melody with accompaniment
instruction_units.instruction: Both hands form a melody-with-accompaniment texture at m.5: one layer carries the melodic line while another supplies aligned support. Melody Gb4-C5 over accompaniment Db4-Eb4.

instruction_units.title: 3. Melody Voicing over Accompaniment
instruction_units.instruction: The texture presents a melody voicing over accompaniment at m.5: the upper line projects while lower tones provide harmonic support. Melody Gb4-C5 over accompaniment Db4-Eb4.
